rows.Kwic: 一絲不掛，萬象齊彰。性相融通，自它俱利。
rows.sourceTitle: 紫竹林顓愚衡和尚語錄

Override.AttributionNote: 紫竹林顓愚衡和尚語錄, instruction on the monastic robe. Zhuanyu Guanheng is the exact author: after describing the robe's transmission and dimensions, he says that with not one thread attached the myriad forms all manifest and nature and marks interpenetrate.
